listing.name: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup
listing.summary: Play the official Windows Tiles build of the open-source tactical roguelike.

steps.title: Start the Windows Tiles edition
steps.instruction: Install the official Windows package and choose Play. The package already includes the game files.

steps.title: Keep custom settings in the Crawl profile
steps.instruction: Place your init.txt in Portcove’s Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup user-data folder. Leave the packaged defaults in the game folder.

warnings: Crawl handles a CRAWL_RC override and any custom data paths outside the Portcove user-data folder. Back up those files separately.

presentation.manual_preparation: No original game files are required. Portcove preserves saves, character dumps, the keyboard macro file and an optional init.txt in the game's user-data folder. Crawl handles a CRAWL_RC override or a custom data path outside that folder separately.
